message.content:
Based on my search, here's how to log in to your Wells Fargo credit card account:

## Wells Fargo Credit Card Login Steps

### Online (Website)
1. Go to **www.wellsfargo.com**
2. Click **"Sign On"** in the top-right corner
3. Enter your **username** and **password**
4. Click **"Sign On"** to access your account

### Mobile App
1. Download the official **Wells Fargo Mobile App** from your device's app store (iOS or Android)
2. Open the app and enter your username and password
3. Tap **"Sign On"**
4. You can also enable **biometric authentication** (fingerprint or facial recognition) for quicker access

### First-Time Users (Enrollment)
If you haven't set up online access yet:
1. Click **"Enroll Now"** on the login page
2. Enter your information to verify your identity (card number, phone number, Social Security number or Tax ID)
3. Create a username (7-10 characters, no spaces) and password (8-31 characters, at least 1 letter and 1 number)
4. Set up security questions

### What You Can Do After Logging In
- View your current balance and available credit
- Make or schedule payments
- Review transaction history and statements
- Set up alerts and spending controls
- Manage rewards
- Add authorized users

### If You Forgot Your Login Information
Click **"Forgot Password/Username?"** on the login page and follow the prompts to reset or retrieve your credentials.

### Troubleshooting
- Make sure you're on the official Wells Fargo website (check for "https://" and the lock icon)
- Clear your browser cache and cookies if experiencing issues
- Update your browser or try a different one
- For mobile app issues, try updating or reinstalling the app

---
